note: Franklin County MA does not zone (towns do). Greenfield publishes its zoning only as PDF maps and ordinance text (no GIS layer). Montague and Athol zoning is shown in AxisGIS web viewers (axisgis.com/montaguema, /atholma) with no public ArcGIS REST service found. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for zoning in Franklin County towns found no queryable district layer; the only Franklin results were Town of Franklin (Norfolk County).
